title: channels__subscribe — input
description: Input schema for the channels__subscribe MCP tool. Registers the calling agent's interest in channels matching a pattern. Subscription persists for the agent's lifetime in the backing store. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §5.3.

pattern.description: Channel name pattern. Supports '*' glob wildcard (e.g. 'ticket:ENGI-*' matches 'ticket:ENGI-0001', 'ticket:ENGI-0042', etc.) and exact match (e.g. 'agent:agent-beta'). Pattern matching semantics follow Unix glob rules applied to the full channel name string.
